en.text:
<primary/>Primary Ammo Weapons deal 100% Increased Damage against <stasis/>Stasis Crystals and 50% Increased Damage against <stasis/>Frozen Enemies.

Also applies to Fighting Lion, Revision Zero, Vex Mythoclast, and their alternate fire modes.

<stasis/>Frozen enemies normally receive <pve 5% /> <pvp [50%] /> decreased damage from <primary/>Primary Weapons. Using the fragment results in a 42.5% overall Damage Increase in PVE and a 25% overall Decrease in PVP.
